components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Three current workspace destinations with the existing shared selection carriage.
components.css: .ds-workspace{position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));width:clamp(456px,46vw,516px);max-width:50vw;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'}.ds-selection{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:calc(100% / 3);padding:4px;pointer-events:none}.ds-selection>span{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#22211f) 9%,transparent);border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#22211f) 5%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#22211f) 2%,transparent));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#22211f) 8%,transparent),0 1px 0 var(--header-nav-key-highlight,transparent)}.ds-selection>span::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:calc(50% - 7px);left:7px;width:2px;height:14px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--wire-orange,#f5572f)}.ds-destination{position:relative;display:flex;min-width:0;min-height:52px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 16px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--header-nav-muted,#625f5a);font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';font-size:14px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:.015em;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:color 180ms ease}.ds-destination svg{flex:0 0 20px;color:var(--header-nav-icon,#625f5a)}.ds-destination[aria-current="page"],.ds-destination:hover{color:var(--foreground,#22211f)}.ds-destination[aria-current="page"] svg,.ds-destination:hover svg{color:var(--header-nav-icon-active,#22211f)}.ds-destination:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#22211f) 5%,transparent)}.ds-destination:active{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#22211f) 9%,transparent)}.ds-destination:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wire-orange,#f5572f);outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:780px){.ds-workspace{width:300px;max-width:42vw}.ds-destination{flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:6px}.ds-destination>span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0;white-space:normal;text-align:center}.ds-selection>span::after{left:9px;height:10px;top:calc(50% - 5px)}}

narrative.overview:
This records One More Prompt's existing orange, paper and ink interface. The owner confirmed the existing logo, system UI typography, saved light/dark appearance and Phosphor icons as the authority for new work. No new visual identity is introduced.

The token inventory below comes from the implemented styles. Semantic CSS properties select the active theme; fixed wire colors keep the brand accent and onboarding action consistent. Setup and guide measurements describe those components, not a required layout for every page.
keyCharacteristics: Orange marks selected state, primary setup actions and the guide target.
Paper/ink surfaces and hairline dividers organize aligned content.
System UI text, Phosphor icons and visible keyboard focus remain shared.
Saved light/dark appearance and reduced-motion preferences apply to setup and guidance.

rules.name: The Theme Rule
rules.body: Use semantic surface and text properties so saved appearance continues to work; use fixed wire colors only where the implementation does.

rules.name: The Motion Preference Rule
rules.body: Setup reveals and guide spotlight transitions are removed when reduced motion is requested; the content and actions remain. Exact timings and easing values are recorded in the sidecar.

dos: Do use the semantic theme properties for surface, text, border and error colors.
Do retain the existing One More Prompt logo and Phosphor icon system.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the reduced-motion rules of each component.
Do keep setup content scrollable while its footer stays available.
donts: Don't replace the approved orange, paper and ink appearance when adding a surface.
Don't turn component-specific measurements into requirements for unrelated screens.
Don't introduce a second product icon library.
